Container.Name: ut2004-server
Container.Requires: Server data will be downloaded to a subdirectory called "server". If you can help it, don't modify anything in there. You should instead put your addons in the "addons" direcotry, and all configuration files will automatically be moved into the "config" directory.

Config.Name: CD Key
Config.Description: Your server CD key. This is needed for first run; afterwards you will see a cdkey file created in the /data/config directory, and can safely remove this environment variable.

Config.Name: Game Type
Config.Description: Initial game type to be loaded.

Config.Name: Mutators
Config.Description: Mutators you want to load, separated by comma (no spaces). For example: UT2Vote61.UT2VoteX,ExcessiveV302.MutExcessive

Config.Name: Server Data
Config.Description: Server data, configuration files, and any addons will be stored here.

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Port used by clients connecting to the server. If this is changed, all of the ports below will need to be recalculated.

Config.Name: Query Port
Config.Description: Port used by clients querying server info. (Game Port + 1)

Config.Name: GameSpy Query Port
Config.Description: Port used for querying more detailed server information. (Game Port + 10)

Config.Name: Server Start Extras
Config.Description: If you need to add any other parameters to the server launch command, put them in this variable. This must start with a question mark (?), as it will be appended to the end of the mutators list in the built server start command.

Config.Name: Server Start Command
Config.Description: If you don't want to use the environment variables to specify map/gametype/mutators/extras, you can just specify the entire server start command here. All except SERVER_START_EXTRAS will be ignored (for legacy purposes, it's appended to the end of SERVER_START_COMMAND).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run the container as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run the container as.

Config.Name: Skip Install
Config.Description: If you don't want to download/update your server files, set this to true. I assume you know what you're doing. Maybe manually installing your own server to the /data/server directory or something? I don't know.
